contract: ../design-qa.md: SCAN Studio for reviewing a real point cloud with paired viewers, live status, and on-demand inspection; preserve truthful data and keep the scene stack and status readable on narrow screens.

accessibility.evidence: Tab from the project selector focuses the inspector button with a visible 2px orange outline. Footer status uses role=status and aria-live=polite; synthetic project API failure uses role=alert and aria-live=assertive. prefers-reduced-motion sets drawer transition duration to 0s. Scene mode selectors have accessible labels.

responsive.evidence: Rendered and inspected at 1670x956, 1280x800 and 375x812. Desktop scenes remain side-by-side; at 375px they stack above the 150px bottom dock. The status strip wraps to 72px, its scrollWidth equals its clientWidth, and the document has no horizontal overflow.

loading.evidence: A browser-tab-only 3-second delay on the project-list GET showed the live footer message 'Загрузка проекта'; the request then completed and project loading resolved.

empty.evidence: Selected the existing read-only Test Proj with zero clouds: the scene explained that a cloud must be loaded and the Import scan command remained enabled. Restored the FARO project afterward.

error.evidence: A browser-tab-only synthetic project-list fetch rejection produced a visible, assertive API error in the footer and kept the last successfully loaded project selected. The failure retained the FARO scenes and saved project ID; after restoring native fetch, reload reopened the FARO project. No server or project data was modified.

partial.evidence: The live 1.rcs view reports 40,000,000 stored points out of 297,873,927 source points and marks the stored cloud as a sample.

success.evidence: After restoring network access, the registered FARO project loaded with two WebGL scenes, 1,482 candidates, and a ready status.

permission.reason: This local desktop workflow has no account, role, or permission-gated screen; file selection uses the browser's normal explicit import control.

renderedEvidence.observation: Live FARO project, paired RGB/height scenes, command ribbon, candidate table, and truthful status strip.
Responsive desktop layout retains paired scenes and the bottom candidate/status areas without horizontal page overflow.
Scenes stack vertically above the bottom dock; the live scan status wraps across two lines without horizontal clipping.
